list.text: Ah!\nMy FARFETCH'D!
You found it for us, kid?\nThank you!
Usually Farfetch'd's loves to cut trees for charcoal.\nBut not this one, I think that's why it ran away.
I don't want to force a Pokémon to do something it doesn't like.
Now, it seems to obey you...?\nI know! Take it on your journey!

then.text: I'm sure it will be much happier and will not run away anymore!

else.text: Oh, you don't have any space for it on your party.
Make some room for it and come back here.

list.text: Do you want to apprentice as a charcoal maker with me?
You'll be a first-rate in ten years!
Oh, man... My boss is going to be angry...
One of the FARFETCH'D that cut trees for charcoal took off in the forest.
Can you catch them for me?
I can't search him here on Ilex Forest...\nIt's too big and scary for me.
Sneak up from behind and catch them...\nDo you think you can do that?
Thank you so much!
My boss's Pokémon won't obey me, because I don't have a Badge.
Phew. You saved me.
Ilex Forest Shrine...
It's a tribute to the forest's protector...
It's a Red Apricorn tree!
The tree is empty...
It's a Red Apricorn tree!
The tree is empty...
This is the lost FARFETCH'D.
Farfetch'd:Far!
Farfetch'd:Far!
Farfetch'd:Far!
Farfetch'd:Far!
Farfetch'd:Far!

else.text: FARFETCH'D is not moving on that direction...

list.text: Farfetch'd:Far!
It's a Red Apricorn tree!
The tree is empty...
Farfetch'd:Far!
Farfetch'd:Far!
Farfetch'd:Far!
What I'm doing?
I'm shaking trees using Headbutt.
It's fun. Here, you try it with your Pokémon, too!

branches.text: I see...\nTake care of its head.

list.text: \f[kimono]\rKimono Girl, Kimono Girl, lost and all alone. Poor girl lost in the dark Ilex Forest.
\f[kimono]\rAnyway, can you show me how to get out of this forest?

branches.text: \f[kimono]\rYou will?\nAren't you lost in the forest as well?\nHow do you know how to get out of here?
\f[kimono]\rMe oh my...\nYou are lost yourself, aren't you?

list.text: \f[kimono]\rWow! Are you going to show me how to get out?\nYou are such a smart Pokémon!
\f[kimono]\rSee you.
Ilex Forest Shrine...
It's a tribute to the forest's protector...
Aaaah! Don’t scare me like that!\nI was just checking if this is really real-life.
Where am I?
I don't know this place.\nAnd you don't look like a villager...
May I ask what year is it?
Wait… it worked?!\nOh no.
I time traveled.\nWith a machine I built. Out of scrap.
Can you give me some spare change to help me rebuild it?
You don't seem to believe me!
Let's resolve this matter in a Pokémon battle!
If you win, I'll give you a proof that I'm from the past.
But if you lose, you will give me the money I need to rebuild my machine!
Let's battle?

branches.text: Ok... A deal is a deal...
This is the proof that I'm really from the past.
In your time, it’s a fossil.\nIn my time it just hatched last week.
If you still don't believe me, there's nothing more I can do!
I need to keep moving so I can rebuild my machine!
It seems people are not so trustyworth in future...
